fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous perimeter fencing confirmed in Street View along the River Road frontage (2025-07 pano Kygql-B2L6N_3Qc4fl8mnw): black ornamental fence rings the employee lot and a controlled drive curves into the complex past the historic 1938 brick admin building. The Street View car was able to drive interior service lanes, indicating a controlled but largely open vehicle gate rather than a hard barrier checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable guard booth resolved at the main River Road entrance from Street View; the entrance reads as a marquee/sign-and-fence employee/visitor gate. Flagged uncertain - a booth may exist at a dedicated truck gate not captured by Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis that a controlled fenced entrance exists but no staffed booth is confirmed; low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - this is a multi-plant campus (Plant #1 at 2995 River Rd plus Plant #4 / Plant #5 and ancillary buildings); web sources confirm 3.1M sq ft across three plants on a 190-acre site. The traced perimeter covers the dominant River Road operational footprint.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is split across faces: a long dock apron runs along the north building face near the rail, while a separate drop/storage yard with trailers and a maroon-roof building sits at the NE corner - distinct clusters on different faces.
fieldNotes.railServed: A large multi-track rail yard sits immediately north of the plant with spurs curving into the NE corner of the property (visible at z18-19). Classic engine/propulsion plant rail service (inbound castings/components, outbound engines).
fieldNotes.dropArea: NE-corner drop yard holds roughly 15-25 parked trailers/containers in rows plus a maroon-roofed building; counted from z19 imagery. Estimated band 10-25.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Dock doors line the north and east building faces near the rail and the staging apron; ~28 is an overhead estimate (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Drop yard plus staged trailers along the River Road service lane could hold ~45 trailers; estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved frontage and a deep interior parking/staging apron along River Road leave ample room to add an express/bypass lane at the gate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance drive off River Road runs deep past the admin building into the interior lot before reaching docks - holds a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site sits inside the Buffalo/Town of Tonawanda metro fabric, bordered by River Road, dense residential street grid to the south, and active industry to the east -> Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified from overhead imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Multiple large connected/adjacent manufacturing buildings plus the brick admin block and the NE drop-yard structure; counted ~4 distinct masses.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Traced perimeter (~102 acres) covers the main fenced Plant #1 operational footprint; the full GM-cited campus is ~190 acres including the northern rail yard and Plant #4/#5.
